guidance: At 21/80 HP, preserve life until the coming rest; the only legal next map node is Unknown. In combat first check guaranteed lethal from current displayed damage, enemy block and retaliation. Take a certain kill rather than needless block. Otherwise minimize this turn's HP loss while progressing the fight. Battle Trance prevents later draws this turn, so sequence it before Pommel Strike when both matter. Use Bash early only if the target survives and Vulnerable pays off. Compare Perfected Strike's live damage as the main burst. Feel No Pain is setup only when a long fight or exhaust triggers justify its energy; True Grit's exhaust is random, so do not assume it removes a specific card. All three potion slots are full: spend a potion when it prevents substantial damage (roughly 6+ HP), enables a kill, or averts a scaling fight. Strength is for several attack turns, Duplicator for a high-impact next card, Distilled Chaos for emergencies with uncertain draws. For events at this HP, avoid large HP payments without a clear survival payoff. For card rewards prefer efficient immediate damage, reliable block, draw/energy, or real Feel No Pain exhaust synergy; skip weak additions. Recheck every action against fresh state; let the controller stop on unsupported mechanics or unavoidable lethal risk.
